items.title: Indian Air Force’s Rafale fleet down to 32, aviation publication says, backing Pakistan’s claim of downing four jets
items.description:
The Indian Air Force (IAF) has 32 French-made Rafale fighter jets in service, down from 36 before the May 2025 conflict with Pakistan, according to estimates published by British aviation magazine Flight International.
The figures lend credence to Islamabad’s claim that it shot down several Indian Rafale jets during the conflict.
In its annual directory of air forces around the world, Flight International listed 32 Rafales in the IAF’s active inventory.

items.title: Lahore once again tops list of world's most polluted major cities, with AQI crossing 300
items.description:
LAHORE: Lahore returned to the top of the list of the world’s most polluted major cities on Wednesday, with its Air Quality Index (AQI) reaching 339, as several other cities in Punjab also recorded hazardous levels of air pollution, according to IQAir.

items.title: 'A ghost from the past': US doctors lament measles resurgence
items.description:

items.description:

items.title: Apple works to restore services after outage caused by internal update
items.description:
Apple said on Tuesday it was working to restore its systems after an internal update caused an outage that affected customer services including iCloud and Apple Pay.
The issue was not caused by a cyberattack, Apple said, adding that many of the systems were back up and running.
“We’re working to get the remaining systems online as soon as possible,” a spokesperson said.
There were around 2,300 user reports of issues with Apple Pay in the US around 12:20 pm ET (10:20 pm PKT), according to Downdetector, which tracks outages by collating status reports from several sources.
